sketch:
Observe: Canvas 2D horizontal spectrum strip; student toggles source
type (thermal continuum / atomic emission / absorption). For
emission and absorption, student picks an element (Na, H, He) from
a picker; the strip renders correct line positions at that element's
λ set. Experiment: 3 seeded target element-spectra; student
identifies element from line pattern. Evaluate: element labels
hidden; student matches unlabeled spectrum strips to element names.
Wrinkle: no dynamic simulation — pure visualization exercise driven
by a small lookup table.
